sections.Profile:
"Festival" is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in January 1967.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Party, Good Times, Dancing, Original Theme, Music
